entities.summary: UCSI University, originally University College Sedaya International (UCSI), is a private university in Malaysia. The university is accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA), the Malaysian Medical Council (MMC), the Malaysian Nursing Board (MNB), and several other professional bodies. UCSI University is a business school in Asia, established in 1986. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
